WorkflowCoach is NovaLearn AI’s upcoming guided workflow assistant, designed to move the platform from static Q&A to active, step-by-step operational coaching [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. It is currently listed as a beta module in the commercial platform and is in a restricted private/internal beta phase [NL-001#NL-001-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S05].

**Current rollout status:** Private beta is enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, primarily mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing, testing factory-floor safety checks and assembly line onboarding [NL-002#NL-002-S07][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. Feedback from this phase has highlighted the need for offline caching of step lists and automated photo verification of physical tasks [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. Until the official public beta, access remains restricted to approved pilot accounts and the timeline is subject to change [NL-002#NL-002-S07].

**Official timeline vs. internal risk:** The official public roadmap targets a September 2026 public beta, with v2.9.0 targeted for September 29, 2026, available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-015#NL-015-S05]. However, internal engineering standups and leadership reviews indicate that dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and Okta permission synchronization engine may push the public release to November 2026 [NL-002#NL-002-S07][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. The CTO states that the September target is in serious jeopardy due to high latency during step transitions (up to 4 seconds) and permission inheritance failures that could expose restricted information to unauthorized users; his realistic estimate is November 2026 [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. Official external messaging still uses the September target, while internal planning is aligning on a November slip contingency, including a possible limited private beta in September for non-regulated customers with flat document structures and no sensitive compliance data [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. Internal action items also call for detailing features deferred to November, including cross-workspace permission synchronization, and defining the September private beta cohort criteria [NL-015#NL-015-S09].

**Planned capabilities:** Admins will be able to ingest procedural documents such as checklists, regulatory compliance manuals, and safety SOPs, and the module will parse them into sequential operational blocks [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. During execution, WorkflowCoach guides employees step-by-step, prompting confirmation of task completion, photo uploads, or compliance answers before advancing [NL-002#NL-002-S07][NL-014#NL-014-S03]. Step records include timestamp, user ID, and input payload in a write-once PostgreSQL compliance log [NL-014#NL-014-S03]. If an operator skips a safety step or fails validation, the session is flagged and the shift supervisor is notified, maintaining an audit history [NL-002#NL-002-S07].
